_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.src: I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.dst: 看來又有一個迷途的靈魂，找上了 {p}！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.src: I see another challenger has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.dst: 看來又有一個挑戰者，找上了 {p}！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.src: I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.dst: 你的樣子並沒有讓我多驚豔。在這裡，誕生的是無數強大而充滿魔力的怪物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.src: Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.dst: Gavel 的各國政府擋不住 Qira 大人。我看你也一樣。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.src: If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.dst: 你想見她，就得把她軍隊的每一支部隊都打敗。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.src: Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.dst: 她雖強大，卻不失氣度。每通過一層，你都會拿到一枚代幣，可以到店裡換取獎勵。祝你好運，冒險——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.src: Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.dst: 什——喔，大人，是嗎？我失禮了……
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.src: Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.dst: 開始吧，雷之部隊！速戰速決，別逗留——待得太久，裡面的東西會扭曲你的心智！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.src: Heeheehahaaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.dst: 嘻嘻哈哈哈！我看見你啦！你們人類的腦袋真是好擺弄，不過我就先把你打個半死吧！過來，快過來！！！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.src: Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.dst: 切，你真沒意思，小騙子！該被打趴的是你，不是我啊！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.src: I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.dst: 我恨死你了。快滾出去跟那個蠢僕人講話啦！！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.src: You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.dst: 你通過雷之層了？真令人意外。那些可是 Qira 大人最早的成功之作。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.src: I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.dst: 遵命，大人。如約定，這是 Thunder Voucher。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.src: Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.dst: 拿去店裡兌換你的獎品。店就在蜂巢的底層。那裡的僕人會告訴你關於獎品的重要事項。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.src: I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.dst: 不過我可不覺得你還值得大人費神。你也想得到，她這裡有太多事要照料。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.src: She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.dst: 很久以前，Gavel 的人愚蠢地想圍攻我們的蜂巢，之後她便與他們立了約。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.src: She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.dst: 她可以繼續她那些違背倫理、甚至可說是邪惡的工作……而作為交換，她不會去打擾 Gavel 的人民。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.src: Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.dst: 接下來你得面對風之部隊，那裡有她更難纏的一些造物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.src: Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.dst: 開始吧，風之部隊！隨風而戰，自由揮灑——在這裡展不開翅膀，將至的風暴就會把你收歸我有！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.src: Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.dst: 哇，能走到這裡真不錯！別跟別人說喔，我等下會手下留情，好嗎？我可是站你這邊的，我們玩得開心點！過來吧！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.src: Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really, really well!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.dst: 嘻嘻，說不定我根本不必留手呢？你表現得真的非常、非常好！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.src: A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.dst: 很多人說我是我們這裡最難纏的，所以你沒問題的！不過接下來要去跟 Yansur 那種人講話，真是辛苦你了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.src: Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.dst: 唔，或許我們是低估你了。風之造物擊敗過成千上萬的人，尤其是——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.src: ...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.dst: 店裡已經備好你的獎勵。你要是還沒跟店裡的僕人談過，下次去的時候記得談。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.src: You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.dst: 你還有很長的路要走。想見 Qira 大人一面可不容易。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.src: Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.dst: 你的下一個目標是清空地之部隊。那裡是有史以來最強悍、最原始的孵化物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.src: Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.dst: 開始吧，地之部隊！你得同時扛住蠻力與劇毒！腳步放快些，否則你就要歸於塵土！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.src: Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.dst: 地之造物竟也擋不住你……大人最原始強悍的那些……全被摧毀了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.src: Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.dst: 好吧，這是你的 Earth Voucher。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.src: It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.dst: 你能走到這一步，確實令人刮目相看。許多人都倒在這裡了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.src: It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.dst: 不過那也無妨，你下一關是水之部隊。我確信你不會成功。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.src: Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.dst: 開始吧，水之部隊！你若擋不住拍擊的浪濤，潛伏其中的生物會確保你永遠浮不出深淵！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.src: You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.dst: 經判定，你有資格與我一戰。然而我清楚你的實力，我不認為那足以擊敗我。上前來吧。試著證明我看走了眼。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.src: Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.dst: 看來我的判斷有誤。不過在此事上，錯得令人愉快。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.src: Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.dst: 繼續前行吧，可敬的人類。或許你的才智與敬意，能感染那個令人難以忍受的 Yansur。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.src: Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.dst: 不可能。連戰術最精妙的怪物都拿不下你。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.src: ... Here's the Water Voucher you're expecting.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#037.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.src: We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.dst: 你的決心引起了我們的興趣……但我們並不擔心。我們不認為你過得了下一層。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.src: Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.dst: 接下來你要面對的，是 Qira 大人想像力所及最難纏的一些生物！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.src: You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.dst: 現在你得面對火之部隊，它必定會把你燒個透。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.src: Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.dst: 開始吧，火之部隊！鼓起你的勇氣，闖過火山的熾熱——否則就隨風化為飛灰！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.src: Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.dst: 能走到這裡，令人佩服。我是你最後的試煉。那麼，我們就堂堂正正地打一場。無論是勝是敗，你的挑戰都該有個體面的收尾。上前來面對我吧。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.src: Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.dst: 隔了這麼久，敗北的滋味有些陌生。不過你打得英勇，也充滿熱忱。要說我失望，那是騙人的。若你願意，把這些品格也帶給大人的僕人，然後去領你最後的獎品吧。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.src: All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.dst: 剩下的只有去跟大人的僕人談話、領取你最後的獎品。他想必不會像我這樣難以逾越。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.src: This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.dst: 這是前所未有的事。你擊敗了最新、也最強大的一批造物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.src: Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.src: This is unorthodox, as few have made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.dst: 這不合常規，畢竟很少有人走到這一步。但我想，這也代表你已經有資格晉見——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.src: Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.dst: 哈！難以置信！大人要親自與你一戰！你真讓我吃驚。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.src: Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.dst: 不過先警告你。這將是你至今最艱難的一戰。Qira 大人是 Gavel 最令人畏懼的存在。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.src: You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.dst: 你會死的……但死在她手上，就當是至高的榮耀吧。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.src: How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.dst: 好個懦夫！在蜂巢裡擊敗了那麼多對手、受了那樣的讚譽，你竟有臉放大人的鴿子？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.src: I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.dst: 我本來已經開始高看你，可是在這種令人作嘔的表現之後——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.src: Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.dst: 什……那——不，那不可能是真的，你——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.src: ...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.dst: ……真是高明……我們窩在這座蜂巢裡太久，久到軍隊都過時了嗎？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.src: To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.dst: 竟敗在一個 Wynn 的人類手上……我不知道該失望還是該驚嘆。我們最終的試煉被攻破了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.src: Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.dst: 那麼，這是你的兌換券。店裡的後間備有你的獎勵。你要是到現在還沒跟店裡的僕人談過……好吧，這時候你也該知道了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.src: Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.dst: 大人……容我說個故事？她曾經被請去協助阻止森林的黯蝕。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.src: With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.dst: 以她無邊的學識與魔法，她一定治得好。但她拒絕了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.src: She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.dst: 她選擇了創造，執著於為某一場戰爭做準備。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.src: Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.dst: 大人從未細說，但看來她知道某些我們不知道的事。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.src: Excuse me, but aren't you forgetting some things, Yansur?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.dst: 恕我打岔，Yansur，你是不是漏了些什麼？

The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.src: You will be disciplined later...fine. Consider yourself honoured to have even a moment of my time, adventurer. Allow me to explain in further detail, my glorious Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.dst: 晚點再處置你……罷了。冒險者，能占用我片刻時間，你該引以為榮。就讓我更詳細地說明一下，我這座榮耀的蜂巢。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#063.src: As Yansur explained, if you wish audience with me, you must prove yourself worthy of my presence by defeating each division of my personal army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#063.dst: 正如 Yansur 所說，你若想晉見我，就得擊敗我私人軍隊的每一支部隊，證明你有資格站在我面前。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#064.src: It consists of five main divisions, each one based around a particular element. Thunder, Air, Earth, and so on. Clearing one will unlock the next for you to face.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#064.dst: 它由五支主要部隊組成，每一支各以一種元素為核心。雷、風、地，依此類推。通過一支，下一支才會開放讓你挑戰。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#065.src: To pass a floor of the division, defeat my forces and put the catalysts they drop into the collector. You will need five catalysts to pass a floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#065.dst: 要通過部隊的一層，就得擊敗我的部下，把他們掉落的觸媒放進收集器。通過一層需要五個觸媒。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#066.src: After nine floors of normal troops, you will face a Division Leader.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#066.dst: 打完九層普通士兵之後，你將面對一名部隊首領。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#067.src: These exceptionally powerful members of my army will be fought alone, and you will only need one catalyst from them to pass.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#067.dst: 這些我軍中格外強大的成員會單獨應戰，你只需要從他們身上拿到一個觸媒就能通過。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#068.src: The Thunder Division will be your first challenge. I do hope you will be entertaining to watch...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#068.dst: 雷之部隊將是你的第一道挑戰。但願你夠有看頭……

The Qira Hive (Quest)#069.src: The mysterious box accepts your tokens. You're free to move on to the next room.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#069.dst: 神祕的箱子收下了你的代幣。你可以前往下一個房間了。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#070.src: How was your first taste of the Hive? Your battle against the Psychomancer was quite the spectacle to behold, ahaha...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#070.dst: 初次領教蜂巢的滋味如何？你與 Psychomancer 的那一戰可真是精彩，啊哈哈……

The Qira Hive (Quest)#071.src: Hush, Yansur. Not a word about her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#071.dst: 安靜，Yansur。關於她的事一個字都別提。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#071.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#072.src: Seems you can move on... All you hear is a bloodcurdling roar. What lies ahead...?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#072.dst: 看來你可以繼續前進了……你只聽見一聲令人毛骨悚然的咆哮。前方等著你的會是……？

The Qira Hive (Quest)#073.src: Well, now that you've destroyed that terrible thing, it seems prudent to tell Yansur and get your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#073.dst: 好了，既然你已經消滅了那個可怕的東西，去告訴 Yansur、領取你的 Earth Voucher 似乎是明智之舉。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#074.src: Managed to defeat Genesis, hm? It is normally the end of most... Interesting.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#074.dst: 居然打倒了 Genesis，嗯？大多數人都會止步於此……有意思。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#074.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#075.src: I must admit I am impressed; the Judge is ruthless... perhaps he needs further tweaking?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#075.dst: 我必須承認，我很佩服；那位審判者可是毫不留情……或許他還需要再調整一下？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#075.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#076.src: Even downed the Vanguard...? My word...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#076.dst: 連先鋒都打倒了……？我的天……
The Qira Hive (Quest)#076.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#077.src: Allow me to stop you there, Yansur. I wish to make an exception for this challenger.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#077.dst: 到此為止吧，Yansur。我想為這位挑戰者破個例。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#077.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#078.src: You have intrigued me, adventurer...and I want to put you to the truest test.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#078.dst: 你引起了我的興趣，冒險者……我想讓你接受最真正的試煉。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#078.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#079.src: I await you in my chambers...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#079.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#080.src: ...you. You...ahaha...I like you. You're capable enough... Perhaps we could be allies in the future...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#080.dst: ……你。你……啊哈哈……我喜歡你。你夠有本事……說不定將來我們能成為盟友……
The Qira Hive (Quest)#080.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#081.src: You defeated Qira! All that's left to do is tell Yansur!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#081.dst: 你打敗了 Qira！剩下的就只差告訴 Yansur 了！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#083.src: You question your mistress? I have nothing to gain from lying to you about this. And there is no shame in admitting defeat.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#083.dst: 你在質疑你的主人嗎？我沒有必要在這件事上對你說謊。而且承認失敗並不可恥。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#083.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#084.src: It is simply a testament to their strength. I will prepare a special reward for them to mark the occasion.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#084.dst: 這不過證明了他們的實力。我會準備一份特別的獎賞給他們，紀念這個時刻。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#084.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#085.src: It is as I have always told you. The darkness is coming...but if you Wynn folk are all as strong as you have proven yourself to be, we may just be able to beat it back.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#085.dst: 正如我一直告訴你們的。黑暗就要來了……但如果你們 Wynn 的人都像你所證明的這般強大，我們或許真能將它擊退。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#085.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#086.src: Honour to you, warrior of Wynn.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#086.speaker: Qira
